name: qa-cache-testing
description: Cache testing across layers: 5 skills (redis-cache-tests, cdn-cache-purge-tests with browser-tier Cache-Control tests in references, varnish-test-vtc-syntax, cache-coherence-patterns-reference with stampede + stale-while-revalidate references, cache-key-discriminator-audit) and 1 agent (cache-key-collision-detector). Covers RFC 9111 HTTP caching and the canonical multi-tier cache discipline (browser to CDN to app to data store).
